json.notes: Chase Center is a near-circular white arena shell about 155 m across, with a flatter, layered roof edge and a tall curved glass lobby wall on the south (front, -z) side under a sweeping overhang. I model the white drum and the lower roof ring as cylinders, the southern glass wall as a curved prism, and the projecting roof canopy as a thin disc.
